objects.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_TYPE3E_3F_COLLISION_CHILD
objects.role: F5-style child template for the shared response stream

behavior: The Type-0x3E and Type-0x3F player-collision dispatch handlers are separate 74-byte producers with identical response setup: they publish the shared movement root at actor field +0x0A, clear transient motion state, set camera values 0x0070/0x0190, and optionally queue event 0x64. The 108-byte MovementVM root queues event 0x29, emits six spawn/copy records for the exact Type-0x84 child template at 0x001B7B5C, and loops through its final step before the next packed entry.
